LanguageData.STQ.Vault.Intro.Title: Access Achieved
LanguageData.STQ.Vault.Intro.Text: The lattice recognizes your credentials. You may extract the artifact core or seal the vault for study. — April
LanguageData.STQ.Vault.ExtractPrep.Title: Extraction Protocol
LanguageData.STQ.Vault.ExtractPrep.Text: Initiating core unlock. Expect a hostile response.
LanguageData.STQ.Vault.SealPrep.Title: Preservation Protocol
LanguageData.STQ.Vault.SealPrep.Text: Sequencing the lattice for long-term stability.
LanguageData.STQ.Vault.Extract.Title: Core Secured
LanguageData.STQ.Vault.Extract.Text: The core is detached and contained. Science teams will be ecstatic—security, stand down.
LanguageData.STQ.Vault.Seal.Title: Vault Sealed
LanguageData.STQ.Vault.Seal.Text: The structure is preserved and stable. Starfleet commends the restraint. Data uplink continues.
